Jeremiah 35 · The Obedience of the Rechabites

points: In the days of Jehoiakim the Most High sent Jeremiah to the house of the Rechabites to bring them into the temple chambers and set wine before them to drink.

note.label: Jeremiah 35: The Obedience of the Rechabites

points: Jaazaniah and the whole house of the Rechabites refused, saying Jonadab the son of Rechab their father commanded them to drink no wine, build no house, sow no seed, and plant no vineyard, but dwell in tents all their days that they might live long in the land.

note.label: Jeremiah 35: The Obedience of the Rechabites

points: They had obeyed the voice of Jonadab in all things, dwelling in tents, and only came to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and the Syrians.

note.label: Jeremiah 35: The Obedience of the Rechabites

points: The Most High tells Jeremiah to point Judah to the Rechabites: the sons of Jonadab kept their father's command to drink no wine to this day, but this people would not hearken to Him though He rose early and spoke.

note.label: Jeremiah 35: The Obedience of the Rechabites

points: He sent all His servants the prophets calling every man to return from his evil way, amend his doings, and go not after other gods, promising they would dwell in the land, yet they would not incline their ear.

note.label: Jeremiah 35: The Obedience of the Rechabites

points: Because the Rechabites obeyed the commandment of their father, Jonadab shall not want a man to stand before Him for ever; but because Judah would not hear or answer, He will bring upon them all the evil He pronounced.
